user.title: Sign in to ClimateConnect
user.description: Use the e-mail address and password you use in the ClimateConnect app.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your ClimateConnect account.
data_description.password: The password of your ClimateConnect account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ClimateConnect again
reauth_confirm.description: ClimateConnect rejected the password for {email}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The password of your ClimateConnect account.

reconfigure.title: Change ClimateConnect password
reconfigure.description: Enter the current password for {email}. To use another account, add the integration again.

data_description.password: The password of your ClimateConnect account.

error.invalid_auth: ClimateConnect rejected the e-mail address or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ClimateConnect. Try again later.
error.unexpected_page: The sign-in showed a step this integration does not support, such as multi-factor authentication or new terms of use. Sign in once in the ClimateConnect app, then try again.
error.no_boilers: This ClimateConnect account has no boilers.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This ClimateConnect account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different ClimateConnect account.

data_description.update_interval: Seconds between status updates. Vacation mode, faults and the tariff update every 15 minutes, energy history every hour.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the boiler's weekly schedule and switches it to Schedule mode.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Per weekday (monday to sunday) a list of switch moments, each with a time and a water temperature in °C. Days left out have no switch moments.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the boiler's mode and weekly schedule, in the format Set schedule takes.

set_tariff.name: Set tariff
set_tariff.description: Sets the electricity tariff ClimateConnect uses to calculate costs. The tariff applies to the whole account.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The day the tariff starts. Default: today. ClimateConnect also changes the dates of earlier tariffs, so a date in the past changes the cost history.

unexpected_page.message: The ClimateConnect sign-in showed an unsupported page at step {step}. Updates are paused until the integration is reloaded.

boiler_not_found.message: ClimateConnect does not know this boiler.

not_a_boiler.message: The selected device is not a ClimateConnect boiler.

boiler_not_loaded.message: The ClimateConnect integration of this boiler is not loaded.

vacation_end_before_start.message: The vacation must end after it starts.

vacation_in_past.message: The vacation period has already ended. Set a new vacation end first.

unexpected_sign_in_page.title: ClimateConnect sign-in needs attention
unexpected_sign_in_page.description: Signing in to ClimateConnect for {title} stopped at an unsupported page (step: {step}). This happens with multi-factor authentication, new terms of use or a changed sign-in page. Sign in once in the ClimateConnect app and complete any extra step, then reload the integration. Updates are paused until then.
